name: radiator_refsim
title: Radiator reference model
summary: Reference simulation of a hot-water radiator: the heat output is the effectiveness times the water capacity rate times the supply-to-air temperature difference, with the effectiveness 1 - exp(-NTU) and the conductance scaled from its nominal value by that temperature difference.

origin.course: ULiège model bank, radiator reference simulation model, 2008-03-17
